messages.subject: For Roger Strevens | Sustainability, Stakeholder Governance & Zero-Emission Strategy | Executive Proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Strevens,

I am writing from Guyana, where I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans ESG, government relations, regulatory coordination, stakeholder governance and executive issue management inside a major industrial operation.

Wallenius Wilhelmsen's zero-emission ambition and global sustainability agenda strongly align with the problems I work on today: converting sustainability commitments into accountable operating actions, strengthening evidence behind ESG claims and coordinating across public institutions, communities and internal business functions.

I prepared a Wallenius Wilhelmsen-specific Strategic Value Creation Proposal rather than sending a conventional CV alone. It outlines where I would add value across sustainability governance, stakeholder strategy, transition execution and responsible-business assurance. My three-page Executive CV forms the final section.

I am open to relocation to Norway and employer-supported work authorization. My strongest fit would be a Director, Head or senior leadership role spanning Sustainability, ESG, External Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or Responsible Business.

I would value a short confidential conversation. If another senior leader owns the most relevant mandate, I would be grateful if you would route the proposal internally.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal: Sustainability Governance, Stakeholder Strategy and Zero-Emission Execution
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Wallenius Wilhelmsen has placed sustainability, governance and the transition toward zero-emission logistics at the center of its long-term strategy. Delivering that ambition requires more than targets and reporting. It requires disciplined ownership of commitments, credible evidence, cross-functional execution and strong engagement with regulators, customers, communities and industry partners across multiple jurisdictions. I bring director-level experience from a multinational resource operation where ESG, government relations, regulatory coordination, renewable-energy deployment and stakeholder commitments must be translated into operating decisions. My contribution would be to strengthen the link between sustainability ambition, stakeholder intelligence and accountable execution across complex country and business interfaces.
strategic_brief.company_context: Wallenius Wilhelmsen operates across shipping and logistics in 28 countries and publicly frames sustainability around governance, people, planet and prosperity. The company is working toward zero-emission shipping and logistics solutions while managing a broad network of customers, terminals, vessels, regulators and local operating environments. Its sustainability priorities include emissions reduction, responsible business and transparent governance. This creates a strong need for practical systems that connect external commitments to internal owners, provide early warning on stakeholder and regulatory issues, strengthen source evidence behind ESG claims and maintain consistency across countries. My background is relevant because I work daily at the interface between corporate commitments, public institutions, operational teams and external expectations in a regulated multinational environment.

opportunities.title: Commitment governance across jurisdictions
opportunities.rationale: Global sustainability programs accumulate commitments to regulators, customers, investors, communities and internal governance bodies. Risk increases when those commitments sit in separate systems without clear ownership, due dates, evidence requirements and escalation paths.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish a practical commitment-governance framework linking external obligations and sustainability promises to accountable business owners, evidence trails, milestones and executive oversight across selected markets.

opportunities.title: Stakeholder intelligence for transition execution
opportunities.rationale: Decarbonisation strategies depend on regulation, port infrastructure, customer adoption, technology readiness and public acceptance. Local signals can materially affect transition sequencing before they are visible in formal reporting or corporate planning.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would create structured stakeholder and regulatory intelligence that ranks market developments by materiality, assigns response ownership and connects local signals to sustainability and commercial decisions.

opportunities.title: ESG evidence and assurance readiness
opportunities.rationale: As sustainability claims become more scrutinised, the quality of underlying source data, ownership and traceability becomes as important as the published narrative. Weak evidence creates reputational and assurance risk even when operating performance is strong.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen evidence ownership, source traceability and internal review routines by applying lessons from carbon-data governance, renewable-energy reporting and cross-functional assurance in a regulated industrial setting.

opportunities.title: Responsible-business integration
opportunities.rationale: Human-rights, transparency and responsible-business obligations increasingly require coordination across procurement, legal, operations, sustainability and external affairs. Fragmented ownership reduces speed and consistency when issues emerge.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help build a cross-functional operating rhythm that links responsible-business obligations, stakeholder issues and executive decisions, with clear escalation thresholds and measurable closure of actions.

days_0_30: Map priority sustainability commitments, stakeholder interfaces and evidence dependencies across selected markets.
Identify gaps in ownership, escalation and assurance readiness.
days_31_60: Introduce a pilot commitments register and stakeholder-intelligence framework.
Align selected sustainability narratives with source evidence and accountable operating owners.
days_61_90: Use live regulatory and stakeholder issues to test the framework and improve executive visibility.
Launch a concise dashboard covering commitments, evidence status, material issues and required management action.
days_91_180: Scale the operating rhythm across additional markets or functions.
Measure improvement through closure discipline, assurance readiness and reduced stakeholder surprises.

potential_impact: Stronger execution discipline behind global sustainability commitments.
Earlier visibility of material regulatory and stakeholder risks affecting transition plans.
Higher-quality ESG evidence and improved assurance readiness.
Closer integration of sustainability, responsible business and operating decisions.
background_relevance: Director-level experience across ESG, social responsibility, government relations, regulatory coordination, corporate affairs and executive advisory inside a multinational mining operation.
Experience coordinating external commitments across Environment, HSE, Legal, Finance, Operations, Procurement, HR, Security and technical functions.
Stakeholder-governance exposure around renewable-energy deployment and carbon-data traceability in a regulated industrial environment.
Senior engagement with government agencies, regulators and investment institutions, with responsibility for translating external expectations into internal action.
